harness.note: Playwright is not installed in this project. This harness uses Chrome DevTools Protocol with request interception; add Playwright in a dedicated dependency PR if a Playwright suite is desired.
harness.apiIsolation: All /api requests are fulfilled by the harness; unhandled /api requests fail with status 502.
